question: Who of the following was one of the stalwarts of a renaissance in Koodiyattam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ammannur Madhava Chakyar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ammannur Madhava Chakyar** was a renowned figure in the world of Indian classical dance and particularly known for his contributions to **Koodiyattam**.
 
• Koodiyattam was inscribed as a Masterpiece of the **Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO in 2008**
 
• He received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1967.**
 
• He was honored with the **Padma Bhushan in 1990.**
 
• **Koodiyattam** is one of the **oldest theatrical forms in India**, with origins dating back over 2,000 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The lead role in Koodiyattam is often played by a Chakyar or Nangyar (female performers).
 
• The art form plays a vital role in preserving the cultural heritage of Kerala and India.
 
• **P.K. Kunju Kurup** (also known as P.K. Kunju Kurup Koodiyattam) was a highly respected figure in the realm of Koodiyattam.
 
• He was honored with the **Padma Shri in 2009.**
 
• **Amubi Singh** is a prominent figure in the field of **Manipuri classical dance**.
 
• **Makar Dhwaja Darogha** is particularly known for his contributions to **Chhau dance.**
 
• Makar Dhwaja Darogha is often associated with the **Mayurbhanj Chhau style of Chhau dance.**
